items.quote: Kindly transfer the total within 21 days of the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Invoice date is 21 November 2026. Under §§ 187, 188 BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date) is not counted, so the 21-day period starts 22 November 2026. Counting 21 days forward: day 1 = 22 Nov, ... day 21 = 12 December 2026. 24 Nov 2026 is confirmed as a Tuesday, so 12 Dec 2026 falls 18 days later = Tuesday + 4 (18 mod 7) = Saturday. Since this is a payment deadline, § 193 BGB moves the end to the next working day: Saturday 12 Dec → Sunday 13 Dec (also non-working) → Monday 14 December 2026, which is not a public holiday in NW. Final due date: 14 December 2026.
